audit.reasoning: The deciding quotation is verbatim at the stated place in the HAL PDF we hold (file p.3 = printed p.2, §2.3; §3.1 table top of printed p.3; fn.3). The source is the only description of Dott/Zoɗi in Glottolog and in Caron's full HAL bibliography; it is a grammar sketch resting on two weeks of fieldwork (Caron's own statement, downloaded now), with a one-sentence tone section, tone-only transcription and pervasive tonal TAM morphology, and no word-stress or accent statement anywhere. Four open Caron papers downloaded now (2002 review, 2003, 2006, 2009) independently restate that Zoɗi has two tone levels and are silent on stress.
